question: Should this protected maintainer-owned umbrella remain the coordination item for the three Wave 1 type-contract cleanup PRs?
rationale: The issue is protected by the maintainer label, assigned to its author, and paired with open partial implementation PRs, so automation should not close or split it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep coordinating the wave
options.body: Keep the issue open while reviewing the three open implementation PRs and close it only after the accepted slices land or are explicitly descoped.

options.title: Narrow after partial landing
options.body: After one or two slices land, update the issue title/body so it tracks only the remaining contract surface.

options.title: Pause the wave
options.body: Close or pause the linked PRs and leave this internal cleanup for a later maintainer-owned audit wave.

recommendation.title: Keep coordinating the wave
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while reviewing the three open implementation PRs and close it only after the accepted slices land or are explicitly descoped.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the issue and all three related implementation PRs, so this is the clearest maintainer-intent route.
